title: 多 Harness 协作架构设计
status: Design proposal; implementation and interoperability are not qualified.
source_scope: Current file snapshots for the linked implementation references and repository contracts. Capturing a digest is not a runtime test.

architecture.diagram_labels: brand-neutral; implementation names are in the design document only

harness_ingress_contract: Gateway uses one transport-neutral Harness Adapter interface. Adapter families: ACP, HTTP/gRPC, native SDK, CLI/process, A2A. Each adapter declares verified capabilities; protocol-specific identifiers remain in adapter bindings. Northbound uses REST and SSE.

source_files.role: Process command sandbox / policy engine (ksandbox); replaces in-tree crates/sandbox

protocol_references.title: ACP v1 Initialization
protocol_references.supports: Version and capability negotiation; absent optional capabilities are unsupported.

protocol_references.title: ACP v1 Overview
protocol_references.supports: Client and Agent roles; v1 prompt lifecycle, updates, permission requests and cancellation notification.

protocol_references.title: ACP v1 Transports
protocol_references.supports: Stdio transport and requirements for separately defined custom transports.

protocol_references.title: A2A Protocol Specification
protocol_references.supports: Agent discovery, tasks, input requests, status events and artifacts; HTTP and gRPC are possible protocol bindings.

methodology_references.title: DDD Reference
methodology_references.supports: Reference for bounded contexts, aggregates, published contracts and anti-corruption adapters.

methodology_references.title: Zero Trust Architecture
methodology_references.supports: No implicit trust from network location or asset ownership; distinct authentication and authorization.

verification.svg_geometry: Previously checked source is byte-identical after rename: 65 labels, no box-bound overflow or text overlap.
verification.visual_review: The previously reviewed diagram is unchanged. Renamed PNG was reopened and its source digest verified.
verification.document_review: Updated Adapter responsibilities, execution-node resources, credentials and artifact boundaries; links use the canonical diagram.
verification.whitespace_check: Each canonical text file checked using git diff --no-index --check against /dev/null; no diagnostics. Exit 1 indicates a new-file diff.
explicitly_not_claimed: Live interoperability of the five adapter types
verification.single_artifact_set: Only harness-gateway.md, .svg, .png and .sources.json remain for this design; dated exports and task scratch files removed.
